objective: Search and apply a filter based on status on the DB1 page in Notion.
notes: Ensure you are logged into Notion before starting.

steps.title: Navigate to Notion
steps.action: Open the Notion application or website.

steps.title: Access DB1 Page
steps.action: Locate and click on the DB1 page.

steps.title: Open Filter Options
steps.action: Click on the filter icon or option.

steps.title: Select Status Filter
steps.action: Choose the status filter from the options.
steps.expected_result: Status filter is applied to the DB1 page.

steps.title: Verify Filter Application
steps.action: Check that the items displayed match the selected status.
steps.expected_result: Items are filtered based on the selected status.

success_criteria: Displayed items match the selected status.
